items.quote: Veya was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of teamwork across departments on the annual review.
Direct reports said that Veya Ashani set the direction for presentations to senior management across the public service.
Direct reports said that Veya contributed effectively to coaching and mentoring junior officers.
Several respondents noted that Veya delivered their share of bilateral negotiations on the water agreement reliably.
Several respondents noted that Veya led evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes across the department.
Direct reports said that Veya set the direction for adoption of new technology tools for case officers across the public service.
Peers observed that Veya Ashani championed long-term strategy for the sector and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Several respondents noted that Veya Ashani led the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined across the department.
Peers observed that Veya took ownership of an end-to-end review of the service ecosystem and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Veya Ashani set the direction for upholding governance and audit standards across the public service.
